text: Up 1.36% since the open at 1247.8, inside the 50% band at N+1. Nifty 50 rose 0.62% (beta 0.47) while the pharma index fell 0.34%, leaving a 1.07% residual. The one news item, an Upstox price page, is unverified and explains nothing. Open trades are up 4.24% since entry, above their 80% range at N+1.

Up 2.96% since the open at 2228, above the 80% band at N+1. Nifty IT rose 2.02% against 0.62% for Nifty 50, so the sector explains much of it, leaving a 0.94% sector residual. Moneycontrol, unverified, links the IT rally to HCL Tech earnings. Open trades are up 2.96% since entry, above their 80% range.

Up 2.6% since the open at 1873.6, above its 50% and 80% 1-day range (80% upper edge 1864.25). Nifty 50 rose 0.96% and the sector only 0.08%, leaving a 1.84% residual. One news item, unverified, first seen since the open, does not explain it. Paper trades at N+1 and N+2 are up 2.6% since entry, above their 80% range.

Up 3.97% since the open at 2249.7, above the 80% range from N+1 to N+5. Nifty IT rose 3.33%, leaving a 0.64% sector residual, so the move is mostly sector-wide; Nifty 50 added 0.96%. Moneycontrol, status unverified, links the rally to HCL Tech earnings. Open down calls run against the move; paper trades are up 3.97% since entry.
